thought.text: Ich sehe das Problem - WorldTick wird nur mit ws construiert, aber braucht viele Parameter! Lass mich das korrigieren:

reasoning_content: I see the problem! In ServerBootstrap, WorldTick is constructed with only ONE parameter (ws), but it expects MANY parameters including persistence. Let me check and fix this properly.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'ENDOFSCRIPT'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Check what parameters WorldTick needs
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("sed -n '302,325p' /opt/areloria/server/src/core/WorldTick.ts")
print("WorldTick Konstruktor:", stdout.read().decode())

# Check where persistence is instantiated in ServerBootstrap
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("grep -n 'PersistenceManager\|new.*Persistence' /opt/areloria/server/src/core/ServerBootstrap.ts | head -10")
print("\nPersistence Instantierung:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
ENDOFSCRIPT
